messages.subject: Error message in RStudio
messages.body_plain:
Hi MSstats,

I am trying to analyse a MaxQuant LFQ dataset using MSstats via RStudio. Using the 'MQ to MSstats converter' script, it reads the annotation.csv, evidence.txt and proteinGroups.txt files fine. But when it comes to the analysis, there is an error message when I try to process the data with the 'quant<-dataProcess(msstats.raw, fillIncompleteRows=TRUE, normalization="NONE", MBimpute=FALSE)' line.

The error message reads 'Error in data.frame(PROTEIN = raw.temp$Protein, PEPTIDE = raw.temp$Peptide,  :
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 1'.

The head rows read:  [1] ProteinName      PeptideSequence  PrecursorCharge  FragmentIon      ProductCharge    IsotopeLabelType
 [7] Condition        BioReplicate     Run              Intensity
<0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)

Could anyone help with this please? I have used these scripts before and they worked fine.

I have uploaded the msstats log file too if that helps.

Best wishes,
Amandeep
